title: Choralim - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Choralim in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Choralim is a fire-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Defense (A), Agility (B).

Location: Sirene's Dress - Chromatic Glissando drop.

sections.title: Is the Choralim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (A), Agility (B). A dedicated fire pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
